title: Bihar (Khazar) (Encyclopedia Article)
text: Bihar (Khazar) From Bihar was a Khagan of the Khazars during the 730s. Bihar was the father of Tzitzak, the Khazar princess who married the son of Byzantine Emperor Leo III who later ruled as Constantine V. He is called Viharos in Armenian sources.
